insights_posts_content.body: {"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime is set to host its first Annual Gala this coming October at the Madareem Hotel in Riyadh, marking a significant milestone in the company’s growth and transformation journey over recent years. The event reflects Startime’s ongoing commitment to strengthening relationships with its partners, clients, employees, and stakeholders, while looking ahead to a new phase of expansion and institutional development.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The inaugural Annual Gala is being organized in recognition of the importance of building lasting connections with the individuals and organizations that have contributed to Startime’s professional journey. It also represents an opportunity to acknowledge the vital role played by partners, clients, and talent in driving the company’s achievements and strengthening its position within the meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events industry. Furthermore, the event will celebrate key milestones in the company’s evolution and highlight significant accomplishments across its operational, institutional, and investment activities.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The evening will feature a comprehensive review of Startime’s achievements throughout the past phase, alongside an overview of the company’s strategic transformation journey and the institutional governance framework, management practices, and operational enhancements that have supported long-term sustainability and growth. The company will also present its future vision and strategic direction for the years ahead as part of its ambition to strengthen its position as a leading national organization in the business events industry and the development of specialized projects and platforms.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"One of the Gala’s most significant highlights will be the official unveiling of Startime Vision 2030, which represents the company’s future roadmap and reflects its aspirations to strengthen its local position while expanding its regional and international presence. The event will also feature the announcement and launch of several new projects representing the first generation of Startime’s investment portfolios. These projects form part of a broader strategic direction focused on business diversification and the development of specialized platforms and initiatives that generate sustainable economic and knowledge value.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Gala will further serve as a platform for announcing additional projects aligned with the company’s diversified investment portfolios, while showcasing future opportunities that Startime aims to develop in collaboration with local and international partners. This direction reflects the company’s commitment to creating initiatives and projects with sustainable impact that support development priorities and enhance the competitiveness of the sectors in which it operates.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Designed as a strategic gathering, the event will bring together partners, executives, decision-makers, government representatives, private-sector leaders, and members of the business community, creating a dynamic environment for dialogue, knowledge exchange, and the exploration of new opportunities. The gathering is expected to strengthen collaboration, facilitate future partnerships, and open broader avenues for integration among stakeholders, ultimately supporting business growth and expanding the economic and knowledge impact of the projects and initiatives led by the company.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Gala is also expected to witness the signing of several partnership and cooperation agreements, in addition to the announcement of new investment contracts that will strengthen Startime’s market presence and accelerate the achievement of its strategic objectives. This reflects the company’s commitment to building an integrated partnership ecosystem that supports growth and creates new opportunities for expansion and development.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The event will receive extensive media coverage through a number of international media outlets and agencies, highlighting the significance of the announcements, initiatives, and strategic partnerships to be unveiled during the Gala. It will also showcase Startime’s future direction and its contribution to the continued growth of the meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events sector.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime confirmed that its first Annual Gala, which the company intends to host on an annual basis, will become a significant milestone in its institutional journey and a platform for celebrating achievements, building upon success, and embracing a new stage of growth driven by innovation, partnerships, investment, and sustainable impact. The event will further embody the company’s commitment to continuously developing its projects and initiatives, expanding its footprint, and pursuing a future defined by clear vision, renewed ambition, and purposeful growth.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"تستعد ستارتايم لتنظيم حفلها السنوي الأول خلال شهر أكتوبر المقبل في فندق مداريم بمدينة الرياض، في خطوة تعكس مسيرة النمو والتحول التي شهدتها الشركة خلال السنوات الأخيرة، وتؤكد التزامها المستمر بتعزيز العلاقات مع شركائها وعملائها ومنسوبيها وأصحاب المصلحة، إلى جانب استشراف مرحلة جديدة من التوسع والتطوير المؤسسي.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"يأتي تنظيم الحفل السنوي الأول انطلاقًا من قناعة ستارتايم بأهمية بناء جسور التواصل مع مختلف الأطراف التي أسهمت في رحلتها المهنية، وتقديرًا للدور الذي لعبه الشركاء والعملاء والكوادر البشرية في تحقيق الإنجازات وتعزيز مكانة الشركة ضمن قطاع اجتماعات الأعمال والمعارض والمؤتمرات؛ كما يمثل الحدث فرصة للاحتفاء بالمحطات المهمة التي شكلت مسيرة الشركة، واستعراض أبرز النجاحات التي تحققت على المستويات التشغيلية والمؤسسية والاستثمارية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وسيتضمن برنامج الحفل استعراضًا لأبرز الإنجازات التي حققتها ستارتايم خلال المرحلة الماضية، إلى جانب تسليط الضوء على رحلة التحول الاستراتيجي التي نفذتها الشركة، وما صاحبها من تطوير لمنظومة الحوكمة المؤسسية وتعزيز للممارسات الإدارية والتشغيلية التي تدعم الاستدامة والنمو طويل المدى؛ كما ستستعرض الشركة ملامح رؤيتها المستقبلية وتوجهاتها الاستراتيجية للسنوات المقبلة، في إطار سعيها لترسيخ مكانتها بوصفها إحدى الجهات الوطنية الطموحة في صناعة اجتماعات الأعمال وإدارة المشاريع والمنصات المتخصصة","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"إن من أبرز محاور الحفل الإعلان الرسمي عن رؤية ستارتايم 2030، والتي تمثل خارطة الطريق المستقبلية للشركة، وتعكس طموحاتها في تعزيز مكانتها محليًا وتوسيع حضورها الإقليمي والدولي؛ كما سيتضمن الحفل الكشف والإعلان عن عدد من المشاريع الجديدة التي تمثل باكورة محافظ ستارتايم الاستثمارية، والتي تأتي ضمن توجه استراتيجي يهدف إلى تنويع الأعمال وبناء مشاريع ومنصات نوعية تسهم في خلق قيمة اقتصادية ومعرفية مستدامة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"كما سيشهد الحفل الإعلان عن مشاريع جديدة ترتبط بمحافظ الشركة الاستثمارية المتنوعة، إلى جانب استعراض الفرص التي تسعى ستارتايم إلى تطويرها خلال المرحلة المقبلة بالتعاون مع شركائها المحليين والدوليين؛ ويعكس ذلك التوجه التزام الشركة بتطوير مبادرات ومشاريع ذات أثر مستدام تسهم في دعم أولويات التنمية وتعزيز تنافسية القطاعات التي تعمل ضمنها؛ ليمثل الحفل منصة استراتيجية تجمع الشركاء والقيادات التنفيذية وصناع القرار وممثلي الجهات الحكومية والخاصة ومجتمع الأعمال، بما يهيئ بيئة خصبة للحوار وتبادل الخبرات واستكشاف الفرص الجديدة؛ كما يسهم هذا التجمع في تعزيز فرص التعاون وبناء شراكات مستقبلية، وفتح آفاق أوسع للتكامل بين مختلف الأطراف ذات العلاقة، بما يدعم نمو الأعمال ويسهم في توسيع نطاق التأثير الاقتصادي والمعرفي للمشاريع والمبادرات التي تقودها الشركة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ومن المنتظر أن يشهد الحفل توقيع عدد من الاتفاقيات وعقود الشراكات والتعاون، إضافة إلى الإعلان عن عقود استثمارية جديدة تعزز من حضور ستارتايم في السوق وتسهم في تسريع تنفيذ مستهدفاتها الاستراتيجية؛ وتأتي هذه الخطوة في إطار حرص الشركة على بناء منظومة متكاملة من الشراكات التي تدعم النمو وتوفر فرصًا جديدة للتوسع والتطوير، كما يحظى الحفل بتغطية إعلامية واسعة من خلال عدد من الوكالات والمنصات الإعلامية الدولية، بما يعكس أهمية الحدث وما يشهده من إعلانات ومبادرات وشراكات نوعية، إلى جانب دوره في إبراز التوجهات المستقبلية للشركة ومساهمتها في دعم نمو قطاع اجتماعات الأعمال والمعارض والمؤتمرات.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وأكدت ستارتايم أن حفلها السنوي الأول الذي تنوي إقامته كل عام، سيمثل مناسبة مهمة في مسيرتها المؤسسية، وفرصة للاحتفاء بالإنجازات المتحققة والبناء عليها، واستشراف مرحلة جديدة من النمو ترتكز على الابتكار والشراكات والاستثمار وصناعة الأثر المستدام؛ كما سيجسد التزام الشركة بمواصلة تطوير مشاريعها ومبادراتها وتوسيع نطاق حضورها، انطلاقًا من رؤية واضحة وطموح متجدد نحو المستقبل.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime Events has announced the establishment of the Startime Alliance, a strategic initiative aimed at strengthening integration among a group of financially and operationally independent Saudi entities, enabling them to enhance their competitive capabilities, expand their business activities, and unlock new opportunities for sustainable growth. The formation of the alliance reflects a firm belief that professional and institutional alliances have become one of the most effective enablers of long-term growth, shared value creation, market risk diversification, and the ability to capitalize on high-potential opportunities in rapidly evolving markets.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In its initial phase, the alliance brings together four Saudi companies operating across diverse yet complementary sectors, united by a shared vision centered on collaboration, the exchange of expertise and resources, and the creation of sustainable value for all stakeholders. The alliance aims to develop and manage portfolios of projects, initiatives, and specialized platforms with an expected market value exceeding SAR 2 billion by 2030, supporting expansion objectives while strengthening the contribution of member entities to economic development.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The establishment of the alliance aligns with modern business practices that have demonstrated the value of institutional connectivity and corporate integration as key drivers of business sustainability, accelerated growth, and more efficient investment in capabilities and resources. The alliance also provides a practical framework for cooperation in business development, investment, project marketing, portfolio management, and the development of future programs and initiatives.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime Events is one of the alliance’s founding members and serves as a leading entity in the development and management of business projects within the meetings, exhibitions, and conferences industry. Over recent years, the company has invested in a range of strategic initiatives and specialized projects that have strengthened its professional standing and enabled it to build an extensive network of local and international partners and clients, positioning it as one of the key drivers behind the alliance’s future direction and growth.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The alliance also includes Impact Events, the operational and execution arm of Startime. A Saudi emerging company specializing in the planning, management, and execution of business events, private functions, and community events, Impact Events focuses on delivering integrated operational solutions that enhance the efficiency and quality of project and event execution. The company continues to experience rapid growth within a promising market driven by innovation, operational excellence, and the development of local and international partnerships.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Another member of the alliance is United Advisory Chamber, the consulting arm of Startime. The company operates as a specialized advisory house with expertise in market research, studies, reports, opinion surveys, and strategic analysis. It is also active in investment facilitation, business matchmaking, business meeting coordination, and the development of commercial and investment relationships. In addition, the company provides professional and creative content development services, together with the preparation of studies and strategic insights that support investment decisions and contribute to business growth.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The alliance further includes Al-Jawdah Manufacturing, an emerging Saudi industrial company investing in metal industries, equipment and machinery maintenance, and spare parts manufacturing. The company is committed to adopting advanced industrial technologies in line with next-generation manufacturing trends. As the industrial supporting arm of the alliance, Al-Jawdah Manufacturing provides the products, solutions, operational infrastructure, and components required by member companies’ projects, initiatives, and events, contributing to greater integration, enhanced supply chain efficiency, and increased value creation across the alliance ecosystem.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime emphasized that the alliance extends beyond collaboration among its founding members and represents the beginning of a long-term journey aimed at attracting additional high-potential entities and integrating them into the ecosystem through clear governance frameworks and institutional operating models that ensure efficiency, sustainability, and effective collaboration. The alliance will also develop modern operating models and joint cooperation programs that enable members to leverage their respective strengths and transform them into opportunities for growth and future projects with sustainable economic and knowledge-driven impact.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The company added that the Startime Alliance embodies a new vision for institutional collaboration based on partnership, integration, and mutual value creation. It provides a practical platform for the development of strategic projects and investment portfolios, enhancing the competitiveness of member entities while supporting their readiness for expansion across local, regional, and international markets.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime concluded by affirming that the launch of the Startime Alliance represents a strategic milestone in its corporate journey and an important step toward building a more integrated and impactful business ecosystem. Through the alliance, the group aims to develop sustainable projects and initiatives while strengthening the role of the private sector in supporting economic development and creating future opportunities.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"علنت ستارتايم إيفينتس عن تأسيس تحالف ستارتايم، في خطوة استراتيجية تستهدف تعزيز التكامل بين مجموعة من الكيانات السعودية المستقلة ماليًا وإداريًا، وتمكينها من رفع قدراتها التنافسية وتوسيع نطاق آعمالها وتطوير فرص النمو المستقبلية؛ ويأتي تأسيس التحالف انطلاقًا من قناعة راسخة بأن التحالفات المهنية والمؤسسية أصبحت أحد أهم الممكنات لتحقيق النمو المستدام، وتعظيم القيمة المشتركة، وتوزيع المخاطر السوقية، وتعزيز القدرة على اغتنام الفرص النوعية في الأسواق المتغيرة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويضم التحالف في مرحلته الأولى أربع شركات سعودية تعمل في قطاعات متنوعة ومتكاملة، تجمعها رؤية مشتركة نقوم على التعاون وتبادل الخبرات والموارد وبناء قيمة مستدامة للأطراف كافة؛ ويهدف التحالف إلى تطوير وإدارة محافظ من المشاريع والمبادرات والمنصات المتخصصة التي يُتوقع أن تتجاوز قيمتها السوقية ملياري ريال سعودي بحلول عام 2030، بما يدعم مستهدفات النمو والتوسع ويعزز مساهمة الكيانات الأعضاء في التنمية الاقتصادية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويُشكل تأسيس التحالف امتدادًا للتوجهات الحديثة في عالم الأعمال، والتي أثبتت أن الترابط المؤسسي والتكامل بين الشركات يمثلان أحد أهم العوامل الداعمة لاستدامة الأعمال وتسريع النمو ورفع كفاءة الاستثمار في الموارد والإمكانات؛ كما يوفر التحالف إطارًا عمليًا للتعاون في مجالات تطوير الأعمال والاستثمار وتسويق المشاريع وإدارة المحافظ والبرامج والمبادرات المستقبلية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وتعد ستارتايم إيفينتس أحد الأعضاء المؤسسين للتحالف، حيث تمثل الكيان الرائد في تطوير وإدارة مشاريع الأعمال قطاع اجتماعات الأعمال وتنظيم المعارض والمؤتمرات؛ وقد استثمرت خلال السنوات الماضية في عدد من المبادرات والمشاريع النوعية التي ساهمت في تعزيز مكانتها المهنية وبناء شبكة واسعة من الشركاء والعملاء محليًا ودوليًا، الأمر الذي يجعلها أحد المحركات الأساسية لمسيرة التحالف وتوجهاته المستقبلية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويضم التحالف كذلك شركة إمباكت إيفينتس، الذراع التشغيلي والتنفيذي، وهي شركة سعودية ناشئة متخصصة في تخطيط وإدارة وتنفيذ فعاليات الأعمال والأحداث الخاصة والمجتمعية؛ وتركز الشركة على تقديم حلول تشغيلية متكاملة تسهم في رفع كفاءة تنفيذ المشاريع والفعاليات، كما تشهد نموًا متسارعًا في سوق واعد يعتمد على الابتكار والكفاءة التشغيلية وبناء الشراكات المحلية والدولية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"كما تندرج ضمن التحالف شركة يونايتد ادفايزوري شامبر، الذراع الاستشاري لستارتايم، والتي تمثل بيت خبرة متخصصًا في مجالات أبحاث السوق والدراسات والتقارير واستطلاعات الرأي والتحليل الاستراتيجي؛ وتعمل أيضًا في مجال الوساطة الاستثمارية وربط الشركاء وتنسيق اجتماعات الأعمال وبناء العلاقات التجارية والاستثمارية، إلى جانب تطوير المحتوى الاحترافي والإبداعي وإعداد الدراسات والرؤى التي تسهم في دعم القرارات الاستثمارية وتعزيز فرص النمو.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويضم التحالف أيضًا شركة الجودة للتصنيع، وهي شركة صناعية سعودية ناشئة تستثمر في الصناعات المعدنية وصيانة المعدات والآلات وقطع الغيار، وتسعى إلى توظيف أحدث التقنيات الصناعية المتقدمة ضمن توجهات الجيل الصناعي القادم؛ وتمثل الشركة الذراع الصناعي الداعم لشركات التحالف، حيث تعمل على تصنيع وتوفير وتوريد الحلول والمنتجات والبنى التشغيلية والمكونات التي تحتاجها مشاريع وفعاليات ومبادرات الشركات الأعضاء، بما يسهم في تعزيز التكامل ورفع كفاءة سلاسل التوريد وتحقيق قيمة مضافة داخل المنظومة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وأكدت ستارتايم أن تأسيس التحالف لا يقتصر على التعاون بين الأعضاء المؤسسين فحسب، بل يمثل بداية لرحلة طويلة نستهدف استقطاب كيانات نوعية جديدة وإدماجها ضمن المنظومة وفق أطر حوكمة واضحة وآليات عمل مؤسسية تضمن تحقيق التكامل والكفاءة والاستدامة؛ كما سيعمل التحالف على تطوير نماذج تشغيل حديثة وبرامج تعاون عشتركة تتيح للأعضاء الاستفادة من نقاط القوة التي يمتلكها كل طرف، وتحويلها إلى فرص نمو ومشاريع مستقبلية ذات أثر اقتصادي ومعرفي مستدام.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وآضافت الشركة آن تحالف ستارتايم يجسد رؤية جديدة للتعاون المؤسسي تقوم على الشراكة والتكامل وتبادل المنفعة، وتوفر منصة عملية لتطوير المشاريع والمحافظ الاستثمارية النوعية، بما يعزز القدرة التنافسية للأعضاء ويدعم جاهزيتهم للنمو والتوسع في الأسواق المحلية والإقليمية والدولية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"واختتمت ستارتايم بيانها بالتأكيد على أن إطلاق تحالف ستارتايم يمثل محطة استراتيجية في مسيرتها المؤسسية، وخطوة مهمة نحو بناء منظومة أعمال أكثر تكاملًا وتأثيرًا، تسهم في تطوير مشاريع ومبادرات مستدامة وتعزز دور القطاع الخاص في دعم التنمية الاقتصادية وصناعة الفرص المستقبلية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As part of its investment strategy aimed at developing specialized business platforms that stimulate investment, facilitate knowledge transfer, and enhance the competitiveness of future-focused sectors, Startime announced the launch of the Saudi International Unmanned Systems Expo (SUS Expo), the first international project within the Startime Business Portfolio, which is dedicated to developing international trade exhibitions, specialized forums, and industry-focused gatherings designed to support market growth, empower high-potential sectors, and create sustainable economic opportunities.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The launch of the Expo reflects Startime’s investment philosophy, which is centered on developing high-value projects aligned with future priorities and national development objectives through clearly defined investment portfolios focused on high-growth and strategically important sectors. Through its Business Portfolio, Startime creates specialized platforms that bring together investors, innovators, manufacturers, and decision-makers under one roof, accelerating the flow of knowledge, strengthening commercial collaboration, and supporting the development of long-term partnerships that generate sustainable economic impact.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SUS Expo is one of the key projects associated with the Advanced Technologies investment track, one of Startime’s core investment domains alongside Defense Capabilities, National Security, Environmental Priorities, and Women Empowerment & Next-Generation Development. The project reflects Startime’s belief that unmanned systems, autonomous technologies, artificial intelligence, semiconductors, and the Internet of Things are no longer simply emerging technologies, but have become fundamental drivers reshaping economies, industries, and markets around the world.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Expo will take place from 25 to 28 October 2027 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC), with the ambition of becoming a global platform that redefines the future of autonomous technologies by integrating innovation, manufacturing, and application within one unified ecosystem. The event is built on a vision that transforms advanced technologies from promising innovations into practical applications and industrial and investment solutions capable of creating tangible impact across economies and societies.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Expo is being launched at a time when the world is witnessing unprecedented transformation driven by the convergence of artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, semiconductors, and unmanned systems. These technologies are rapidly expanding across civil, commercial, industrial, and defense sectors. Global indicators further suggest that unmanned systems have become a central component of a technology ecosystem expected to exceed USD 5 trillion by 2030, positioning the sector among the most influential forces shaping the future global economy.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Saudi International Unmanned Systems Expo is built around three strategic pillars: Innovation, Manufacturing, and Application. The Innovation pillar focuses on showcasing breakthrough ideas and emerging technologies while fostering an environment that supports research, development, and talent discovery. The Manufacturing pillar emphasizes technology localization, advanced supply chains, industrial capability development, and local content enhancement. The Application pillar is dedicated to transforming technological advances into practical solutions capable of delivering real-world value across economic and development sectors.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The event extends far beyond a traditional trade exhibition. Its integrated program includes a professional conference bringing together experts, industry leaders, and decision-makers, a global innovation hackathon, a comprehensive business and investment meetings program, and an official opening ceremony designed to highlight the significance of the event and its role in shaping the future of advanced technologies. This integrated structure aims to establish a global platform capable of connecting innovation with application and investment with manufacturing within a highly specialized professional environment.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SUS Expo aims to attract companies and institutions across fifteen specialized sectors, including unmanned systems, artificial intelligence and analytics, semiconductors and microelectronics, the Internet of Things and smart infrastructure, imaging and sensing technologies, autonomous control systems, software solutions and systems integration, cybersecurity, smart safety and security technologies, specialized robotics, logistics and supply chains, smart energy technologies, entertainment, media and events, education, training and simulation, and future smart cities, creating a comprehensive platform that covers the entire advanced technology value chain.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Expo also addresses more than twenty application domains representing some of the world’s most significant future priorities and emerging market opportunities, including national security, energy, digital health, Industry 4.0, smart agriculture, smart mining, intelligent transportation, industrial safety, environmental sustainability, defense support, smart cities, geographic information systems, supply chains, media and entertainment, and other sectors experiencing rapid demand for autonomous technologies and intelligent systems.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SUS Expo is designed to support the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 by encouraging investment in advanced technologies, facilitating technology transfer and localization, strengthening national supply chains, stimulating innovation and entrepreneurship, empowering startups, and attracting high-value international partnerships. It also seeks to reinforce Saudi Arabia’s position as a regional hub for unmanned systems, intelligent applications, and advanced manufacturing while creating a more attractive environment for investors, manufacturers, innovators, and technology leaders from around the world.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The event is expected to attract more than 500 participating organizations from over 30 countries, in addition to 80,000+ visitors, 500+ investors and decision-makers, and more than 1,000 business meetings, while targeting commercial and investment opportunities exceeding USD 1 billion. These indicators reflect the scale of the project’s ambitions and its anticipated role in stimulating investment, accelerating industrial localization, and strengthening Saudi Arabia’s competitiveness within one of the fastest-growing industries globally.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime emphasized that the launch of SUS Expo 2027 represents a significant milestone in the growth of the Startime Business Portfolio and a practical expression of its investment philosophy, which focuses on developing specialized projects that address market gaps, respond to emerging trends, and support national development priorities. The project reflects the company’s commitment to contributing to a more competitive and sustainable economy through the development of international platforms that bring together innovation, manufacturing, investment, and knowledge under one roof, creating lasting economic and knowledge-based impact for years to come.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"في إطار استراتيجيتها الاستثمارية الرامية إلى تطوير منصات أعمال متخصصة تسهم في تحفيز الاستثمار ونقل المعرفة وتعزيز تنافسية القطاعات المستقبلية، أعلنت ستارتايم عن إطلاق المعرض السعودي الدولي للأنظمة غير المأهولة ليكون أول مشروع دولي ضمن محفظة ستارتايم للأعمال، والتي تختص بتطوير المعارض التجارية الدول SU والمنتديات والملتقيات المتخصصة الهادفة إلى دعم نمو الأسواق والقطاعات الواعدة وخلق فرص اقتصادية مستدامة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويأتي إطلاق المعرض امتدادًا لفلسفة الاستثمار التي تتبناها ستارتايم، والقائمة على تطوير مشاريع نوعية ترتبط مباشرة باولويات المستقبل ومستهدفات التنمية الوطنية، ضمن محافظ استثمارية واضحة تستهدف القطاعات ذات النمو المرتفع والقيمة الاستراتيجية؛ ومن خلال محفظة الأعمال، تعمل ستارتايم على ابتكار منصات متخصصة تجمع المستثمرين والمبتكرين والمصنعين وصناع القرار تحت مظلة واحدة، بما يُسرع تدفق المعرفة ويعزز التعاون التجاري ويدعم بناء شراكات طويلة المدى ذات أثر اقتصادي مستدام.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويُعد معرض SUS Expo أحد المشاريع المرتبطة بمسار التقنيات المتقدمة، الذي يمثل أحد المسارات الاستثمارية الرئيسية لستارتايم، إلى جانب القدرات الدفاعية والآمن الوطني والقضايا البيئية وتمكين المرآة وتنمية الآجيال؛ ويعكس المشروع قناعة ستارتايم بأن الأنظمة غير المأهولة والتقنيات المستقلة والذكاء الاصطناعي وأشباه الموصلات وإنترنت الأشياء لم تعد تقنيات مستقبلية فحسب، بل أصبحت محركات رئيسية لإعادة تشكيل الاقتصادات والقطاعات والأسواق في مختلف آنحاء العالم.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويُقام المعرض خلال الفترة من 25 إلى 28 أكتوبر 2027 في مركز الرياض الدولي للمؤتمرات والمعارض، مستهدفًا أن كون منصة عالمية تعيد تعريف مستقبل التقنيات المستقلة من خلال دمج الابتكار والتصنيع والتطبيق في منظومة واحدة متكاملة؛ ويستند الحدث إلى رؤية تقوم على تحويل التقنيات المتقدمة من مجرد ابتكارات واعدة إلى تطبيقات عملية وحلول استثمارية وصناعية قادرة على إحداث آثر مباشر في الاقتصادات والمجتمعات.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويأتي المعرض في وقت يشهد فيه العالم تحولًا غير مسبوق بفعل التكامل المتسارع بين الذكاء الاصطناعي وإنترنت الأشياء وأشباه الموصلات والأنظمة غير المأهولة، حيث تتوسع استخدامات هذه التقنيات في القطاعات المدنية والتجارية والصناعية والدفاعية بوتيرة متسارعة؛ كما تشير المؤشرات العالمية إلى أن الأنظمة غير المأهولة أصبحت جزءًا من منظومة تقنية عالمية يتوقع أن تتجاوز قيمتها خمسة تريليونات دولار بحلول عام 2030، وهو ما يجعلها من أكثر القطاعات تأثيرًا في مستقبل الاقتصاد العالمي","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويرتكز المعرض السعودي الدولي للأنظمة غير المأهولة على ثلاثة محاور استراتيجية رئيسية تتمثل في الابتكار والتصنيع والتطبيق، حيث يعمل محور الابتكار على استعراض أحدث الأفكار والتقنيات الناشئة وتوفير بيئة محفزة للبحث والتطوير واكتشاف المواهب؛ أما محور التصنيع فيركز على توطين الصناعات التقنية وسلاسل الإمداد المتقدمة وتعزيز المحتوى المحلي ونقل المعرفة الصناعية، فيما يهدف محور التطبيق إلى تحويل هذه المنجزات التقنية إلى حلول عملية قابلة للتنفيذ في مختلف القطاعات الاقتصادية والتنموية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ولا يقتصر الحدث على معرض تجاري فقط، بل تتكامل فعالياته لتضم مؤتمرًا مهنيًا للخبراء والقادة وصناع القرار، وهاكثون عالميًا للابتكار، وبرنامجًا لاجتماعات الأعمال والاستثمار، إضافة إلى حفل افتتاح رسمي مصمم لإبراز أهمية الحدث ودوره في تشكيل مستقبل التقنيات المتقدمة؛ ويهدف هذا التكامل إلى بناء منصة عالمية قادرة على ربط الابتكار بالتطبيق والاستثمار بالتصنيع ضمن بيئة مهنية متخصصة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويستهدف معرض SUS Expo استقطاب الشركات والمؤسسات العاملة في خمسة عشر قطاعًا تخصصيًا تشمل الآنظمة غير المأهولة، والذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات، والرقائق الإلكترونية وأشباه الموصلات، وإنترنت الأشياء والبنية الذكية، والتصوير والاستشعار، وانظمة التحكم والتشغيل الذاتي، والحلول البرمجية والتكامل، والآمن السيبراني، والأمن والسلامة الذكية، والروبوتات المتخصصة، والخدمات اللوجستية وسلاسل الإمداد، وتقنيات الطاقة الذكية، وقطاعات الترفيه والإعلام والفعاليات، والتعليم والتدريب والمحاكاة، ومدن المستقبل الذكية؛ بما يجعل المعرض منصة متكاملة لسلسلة القيمة التقنية بأكملها","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"كما يغطي المعرض أكثر من عشرين مجالًا تطبيقيًا تمثل أبرز أولويات المستقبل والاتجاهات العالمية الصاعدة، من بينها الأمن الوطني، والطاقة، والصحة الرقمية، والصناعة 4.0، والزراعة الذكية، والتعدين الذكي، والنقل الذكي، والسلامة الصناعية، والبيئة، والإسناد الدفاعي، والمدن الذكية، ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية، وسلاسل الإمداد، والترفيه والإعلام، وغيرها من المجالات التي تشهد طلبًا متزايدًا على التقنيات المستقلة والأنظمة الذكية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويهدف SUS Expo إلى دعم مستهدفات رؤية السعودية 2030 من خلال تعزيز الاستثمار في التقنيات المتقدمة، ونقل وتوطين المعرفة، وتطوير سلاسل الإمداد الوطنية، وتحفيز الابتكار وريادة الأعمال، وتمكين الشركات الناشئة، واستقطاب الشراكات الدولية النوعية. كما يسعى إلى ترسيخ مكانة المملكة العربية السعودية كمركز إقليمي للأنظمة غير المأهولة والتطبيقات الذكية والتصنيع المتقدم، وبناء بيئة أكثر جاذبية للمستثمرين والمصنعين والمبتكرين من مختلف أنحاء العالم.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ومن المتوقع أن يستقطب الحدث أكثر من 500 جهة مشاركة من أكثر من 30 دولة، إلى جانب أكثر من 80 ألف زائر، وأكثر من 500 مستثمر ومتخذ قرار، وتنظيم ما يزيد على ألف اجتماع أعمال، مع استهداف فرص تجارية واستثمارية تتجاوز قيمتها مليار دولار أمريكي. وتعكس هذه المؤشرات حجم الطموح الذي يقف خلف المشروع والدور المتوقع له في تحفيز الاستثمار وتسريع التوطين الصناعي وتعزيز تنافسية المملكة في واحدة من أسرع الصناعات نموًا في العالم.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وآكدت ستارتايم آن إطلاق SUS Expo 2027 يمثل محطة مهمة في مسيرة نمو محفظة ستارتايم للأعمال، وتجسيدًا عمليًا لفلسفتها الاستثمارية التي تقوم على تطوير مشاريع نوعية تُعالج فجوات السوق وتستجيب للاتجاهات المستقبلية وتدعم مستهدفات التنمية الوطنية. كما يعكس المشروع التزام الشركة بالمساهمة في بناء اقتصاد أكثر تنافسية واستدامة من خلال تطوير منصات دولية متخصصة تجمع الابتكار والتصنيع والاستثمار والمعرفة تحت سقف واحد، وتخلق أثرًا اقتصاديًا ومعرفيًا يمتد لسنوات طويلة قادمة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime has announced its membership in the International Association of Exhibitions and Events (IAEE), one of the world’s leading professional organizations dedicated to the exhibitions and events industry. This milestone reflects the company’s commitment to expanding its international presence, advancing its professional capabilities, and aligning its institutional practices with globally recognized industry standards. Recognized as the global voice of the exhibitions and events industry, IAEE has been supporting industry growth, professional development, and knowledge exchange since 1928.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This membership forms part of Startime’s broader journey toward building a more influential, competitive, and sustainable organization. It enables the company’s team to access world-class industry knowledge, professional best practices, and global expertise, while strengthening its ability to develop projects and business platforms that align with international standards and respond to the rapidly evolving exhibitions, events, and business meetings landscape.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Joining IAEE represents a strategic step that extends beyond conventional professional networking. Through this membership, Startime gains access to a global ecosystem that includes exhibition organizers, event owners, venue operators, destination management companies, convention and exhibition centers, industry experts, and business leaders from around the world. The membership also provides opportunities to exchange knowledge and experience, explore emerging trends and technologies, and adopt advanced operational models that contribute to improving execution quality, operational efficiency, and the competitiveness of the projects and events developed by the company.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The move further reflects Startime’s commitment to investing in human capital and continuously developing the professional capabilities of its team. The company firmly believes that international exposure and global expertise are among the most important enablers of sustainable growth and institutional excellence. Through IAEE membership, Startime gains access to professional development programs, specialized training opportunities, industry research, thought leadership resources, and professional communities that help advance skills and strengthen readiness for the future of the industry.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This milestone aligns directly with the second pillar of Startime Vision 2030, Global Presence, which focuses on expanding the company’s international footprint through strategic partnerships, globally attractive projects, and the attraction of international investment and foreign capital. Through this vision, Startime seeks to contribute to positioning Saudi Arabia as a leading global destination for business events, exhibitions, and specialized industry platforms.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime believes that building relationships with influential international industry organizations is one of the most effective pathways toward achieving this objective and strengthening its presence within the global exhibitions and events ecosystem. Membership in IAEE reinforces the company’s ability to engage with international stakeholders, participate in professional dialogue, and contribute to the advancement of industry standards and practices worldwide.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The membership also strengthens Startime’s ability to expand its international network and establish strategic relationships with leading global organizations and industry partners. This creates new opportunities for collaboration, knowledge exchange, joint initiatives, and the attraction of international events and business platforms to Saudi Arabia. These efforts support the company’s ambition to develop projects capable of competing on a global scale while attracting exhibitors, participants, investors, and visitors from international markets.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime emphasizes that global presence is not defined solely by geographical expansion. It also requires professional credibility, institutional reputation, and active engagement with the organizations that shape the future of the exhibitions and events industry. From this perspective, membership in IAEE represents a valuable addition to the network of professional relationships and strategic partnerships that the company continues to build in support of its long-term growth and development objectives.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The company further expects this membership to generate positive outcomes across its current and future projects, particularly as it continues expanding its portfolio of international trade exhibitions, specialized forums, and industry-focused events; Membership will provide greater access to international expertise, global speakers, institutional partners, exhibitors, and key industry stakeholders, helping strengthen the international positioning and appeal of Startime’s projects and platforms.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime concluded by affirming that joining the International Association of Exhibitions and Events (IAEE) represents an important milestone in its institutional development journey and a significant step toward achieving the objectives of its Vision 2030; Through strengthening global presence, developing professional capabilities, building international partnerships, and expanding global engagement, the company aims to further support Saudi Arabia’s position as a world-class destination for exhibitions, events, business meetings, and specialized industry platforms.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"أعلنت ستارتايم انضمامها إلى الرابطة الدولية للمعارض والفعاليات %! IAE ،! إحدى أبرز المنظمات المهنية العالمية المتخصصة في صناعة المعارض والفعاليات، في خطوة تعكس التزام الشركة بتعزيز حضورها الدولي وتطوير قدراتها المهنية والارتقاء بممارساتها المؤسسية وفق أفضل المعايير العالمية المتبعة في القطاع؛ وتعد JAEE الصوت العالمي صناعة المعارض والفعاليات، وتعمل منذ عام 1928 على دعم نمو القطاع وبناء المجتمعات المهنية وتبادل المعرفة والخبرات بين الجهات العاملة في هذه الصناعة على مستوى العالم.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويأتي هذا الانضمام ضمن مسيرة ستارتايم الرامية إلى بناء مؤسسة أكثر تأثيرًا وتنافسية واستدامة، وتمكين كوادرها من الوصول إلى أحدث المعارف والممارسات المهنية العالمية، وتعزيز قدرتها على تطوير مشاريع ومنصات أعمال تتوافق مع المعايير الدولية وتواكب التحولات المتسارعة التي تشهدها صناعة المعارض والفعاليات والأحداث المتخصصة","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويمثل انضمام ستارتايم إلى IAEE خطوة استراتيجية تتجاوز البعد المهني التقليدي، حيث يتيح لستارتايم الوصول إلى منظومة عالمية واسعة تضم منظمي المعارض وملاك الفعاليات وشركات إدارة الوجهات ومراكز المعارض والمؤتمرات والخبراء والمتخصصين وقادة القطاع من مختلف دول العالم؛ كما يوفر فرصًا أكبر لتبادل الخبرات والمعرفة المهنية والاطلاع على أحدث التوجهات والتقنيات والنماذج التشغيلية التي تسهم في رفع كفاءة الأداء وتحسين جودة التنفيذ وتعزيز تنافسية المشاريع والفعاليات التي تطورها الشركة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويعكس هذا التوجه التزام ستارتايم بالاستثمار المستمر في تطوير رأس المال البشري وبناء القدرات المهنية لفريق العمل، انطلاقًا من قناعتها بأن المعرفة والخبرة الدولية تمثلان أحد أهم الممكنات لتحقيق النمو المستدام والتميز المؤسسي؛ كما تتيح عضوية الرابطة فرصًا متعددة للتدريب والتأهيل المهني والوصول إلى البرامج المتخصصة والدراسات والبحوث ومجتمعات المعرفة المهنية التي تسهم في تطوير المهارات ورفع الجاهزية لمواكبة مستقبل الصناعة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وتنسجم هذه الخطوة بشكل مباشر مع المحور الثاني من رؤية ستارتايم 2030 والمتمثل في الحضور العالمي، والذي يركز على توسيع حضور الشركة دوليًا من خلال بناء الشراكات الدولية وتطوير المشاريع ذات الجاذبية العالمية واستقطاب الاستثمارات ورؤوس الأموال الأجنبية، بما يعزز مكانة المملكة العربية السعودية كمركز دولي للأعمال والأحداث المتخصصة؛ وتؤمن ستارتايم بأن بناء العلاقات مع المنظمات المهنية الدولية يمثل أحد المسارات الفاعلة لتحقيق هذا التوجه وترسيخ حضورها ضمن المنظومة العالمية لصناعة المعارض والفعاليات.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"كما يعزز الانضمام إلى IAEE قدرة ستارتايم على توسيع شبكة علاقاتها الدولية وبناء شراكات نوعية مع مؤسسات وشركات عالمية متخصصة، الأمر الذي يفتح المجال آمام فرص جديدة للتعاون وتبادل الخبرات وتطوير مشاريع مشتركة واستقطاب فعاليات ومنصات أعمال دولية إلى المملكة العربية السعودية. وتنسجم هذه الجهود مع طموحات الشركة في تطوير مشاريع قادرة على المنافسة عالميًا واستقطاب المشاركين والعارضين والزوار والمستثمرين من مختلف الآسواق الدولية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وتؤكد ستارتايم أن بناء الحضور الدولي لا يقتصر على التوسع الجغرافي فحسب، بل يشمل أيضًا ترسيخ الموثوقية المهنية وتعزيز السمعة المؤسسية والارتباط بالمؤسسات المرجعية المؤثرة في صناعة المعارض والفعاليات العالمية. ومن هذا المنطلق، يمثل الانضمام إلى IAEE إضافة نوعية لمنظومة الشراكات والعلاقات المهنية التي تعمل الشركة على بنائها لدعم نموها المؤسسي وتعزيز قدرتها على تقديم مشاريع وفعاليات تواكب أفضل الممارسات العالمية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"كما ترى ستارتايم أن هذه العضوية ستنعكس إيجابًا على مشاريعها الحالية والمستقبلية، خصوصًا في ظل توسعها في تطوير المعارض التجارية الدولية والمنتديات والملتقيات المتخصصة ضمن محافظها الاستثمارية المختلفة، حيث ستوفر لها فرصًا أكبر للوصول إلى الخبرات الدولية واستقطاب المتحدثين والشركاء والعارضين وبناء علاقات استراتيجية مع الجهات المؤثرة في القطاع على مستوى العالم.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وأكدت ستارتايم أن انضمامها إلى الرابطة الدولية للمعارض والفعاليات IAEE يمثل محطة مهمة ضمن رحلة تطويرها المؤسسي، وخطوة جديدة نحو تحقيق مستهدفات رؤيتها 2030، من خلال تعزيز الحضور العالمي، وتنمية القدرات المهنية، وبناء الشراكات الدولية، ودعم مكانة المملكة العربية السعودية بوصفها وجهة عالمية رائدة لصناعة المعارض والفعاليات والأحداث المتخصصة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime has announced the organization of the 4th Saudi International Maritime Forum, in cooperation with the Royal Saudi Naval Forces, scheduled to take place from 23 to 25 November 2026 at the Sofitel Riyadh Hotel & Convention Center, under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Khalid bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Minister of Defense. The organization of the Forum represents a continuation of the strategic partnership between the Royal Saudi Naval Forces and Startime, reflecting the mutual trust established through the successful delivery of previous editions and reinforcing the Forum’s position as one of the leading international platforms dedicated to maritime security affairs.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Saudi International Maritime Forum represents one of the flagship projects within the Startime Government Portfolio, which is dedicated to developing national initiatives and high-level business events that support the objectives of government entities, as well as the programs and projects of Saudi Vision 2030. Through this portfolio, Startime develops platforms for dialogue and collaboration that bring together decision-makers, experts, and leaders of critical sectors. In line with this approach, the company continues to create specialized events with both national and international dimensions, contributing to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for strategic dialogue and international cooperation on matters of shared importance.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The launch of the fourth edition comes at a time when the international maritime environment is undergoing rapid transformation, accompanied by growing concern over the security of seas, strategic waterways, and critical infrastructure extending across the seabed. Subsea data cables carrying global communications, energy pipelines, and underwater strategic assets have become essential enablers of the global digital economy, international trade, and worldwide energy security. As a result, the need for specialized international platforms to discuss the future protection of these vital assets and strengthen international cooperation has become increasingly important.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In response to these developments, the fourth edition of the Forum will be organized under the theme: The Future of Seabed Security and Maritime Supply Chains in a Critically Changing World; This theme reflects the growing significance of deep-sea infrastructure security and its role in supporting global economic stability, international trade, energy flows, and communications networks. It also demonstrates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s commitment to supporting international efforts aimed at enhancing maritime corridor security and protecting the shared interests of nations and peoples.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Forum also embodies one of Startime’s key investment pathways within the National Security domain, which serves as a fundamental pillar of the company’s investment philosophy. Startime believes that accelerating global transformations require the development of an integrated security framework encompassing maritime security, supply chain resilience, cybersecurity, and economic security. Through its specialized projects, the company seeks to establish platforms that bring together government entities, experts, and international partners to strengthen national preparedness and support sustainable economic and social development.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Forum is expected to attract distinguished naval leaders, policymakers, government officials, international experts, industrial and technology companies, and specialized research institutions to participate in a high-level international dialogue on the future of maritime security and its related opportunities and challenges. Discussions will address a number of priority topics of growing relevance to governments and international organizations, including the protection of subsea digital infrastructure, maritime energy security, global supply chain resilience, maritime cybersecurity, and the role of unmanned systems, artificial intelligence, and advanced technologies in enhancing maritime security, improving surveillance capabilities, strengthening response mechanisms, and advancing risk management.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Forum’s Higher Organizing Committee, operating under the direct supervision of the supervisory committee of the Royal Saudi Naval Forces, is implementing a comprehensive preparation plan that includes the development of the scientific program, coordination with government, military, and international stakeholders, engagement with speakers and subject-matter experts, and the deployment of the operational and technical infrastructure required to deliver a world-class experience commensurate with the significance of the event and the Kingdom’s international standing. Organizations, experts, and participating entities from more than forty countries have already begun confirming their participation, reflecting the Forum’s growing importance as a global platform for dialogue and cooperation on maritime security issues.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Saudi International Maritime Forum serves as a practical embodiment of the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 through strengthening the Kingdom’s international presence, expanding global partnerships, and reinforcing its position as a regional and international hub for specialized business events and strategic dialogue. It also reflects Saudi Arabia’s growing role in supporting international maritime security, protecting vital maritime corridors, and contributing to the stability of global trade and energy markets as a nation whose economic and strategic interests are closely linked to maritime security and the uninterrupted flow of international commerce.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime believes that the success achieved by previous editions confirms the importance of building specialized dialogue platforms that bring together international expertise, facilitate knowledge exchange, and promote cooperation among military, governmental, industrial, and technological institutions, particularly in light of the increasing challenges facing the global maritime domain. This approach aligns with the company’s vision of developing high-impact national projects that support the Kingdom’s priorities, enhance national competitiveness, and create long-term economic and knowledge- based value.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Startime emphasized that organizing the fourth edition of the Saudi International Maritime Forum represents a continuation of its journey in developing high-level international business events and a new milestone in its mission to build specialized dialogue platforms dedicated to strategic priority issues. The event further reflects Startime’s commitment to supporting global maritime security, strengthening international cooperation, and advancing specialized knowledge in a manner that aligns with Saudi Arabia’s vision and aspirations for a safer, more sustainable, and more prosperous future.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"أعلنت ستارتايم عن تنظيم النسخة الرابعة من الملتقى البحري السعودي الدولي، بالتعاون مع القوات البحرية الملكية السعودية، والمقرر انعقاده خلال الفترة من 23 إلى 25 نوفمبر 2026 في فندق ومركز مؤتمرات سوفيتيل الرياض، تحت رعاية كريمة من صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير خالد بن سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود، وزير الدفاع، ويأتي تنظيم الملتقى امتدادًا للشراكة الاستراتيجية القائمة بين القوات البحرية الملكية السعودية وشركة ستارتايم، وتجسيدًا للثقة المتبادلة التي أثمرت عن نجاح النسخ السابقة وترسيخ مكانة الملتقى كأحد أبرز المنصات الدولية المتخصصة في قضايا الأمن البحري.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويمثل الملتقى البحري السعودي الدولي أحد المشاريع الرئيسية ضمن محفظة ستارتايم للحكومات، والتي تستهدف تطوير مبادرات وطنية وفعاليات أعمال رفيعة المستوى تدعم مستهدفات الجهات الحكومية وبرامج ومشاريع رؤية السعودية 2030، وتسهم في بناء منصات للحوار والتعاون تجمع صناع القرار والخبراء وقادة القطاعات الحيوية؛ ومن خلال هذا التوجه، تواصل ستارتايم تطوير فعاليات نوعية ذات بعد وطني ودولي تسهم في تعزيز مكانة المملكة العربية السعودية كمركز عالمي للحوار الاستراتيجي والتعاون الدولي حول القضايا ذات الأهمية المشتركة.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وياتي إطلاق النسخة الرابعة من الملتقى في وقت يشهد فيه العالم تحولات متسارعة في البيئة البحرية الدولية، وتزايدًا في أهمية أمن البحار والممرات المائية والبنية التحتية الحيوية الممتدة عبر أعماق البحار؛ فقد أصبحت الكابلات البحرية التي تنقل البيانات العالمية وآنابيب الطاقة والمنشآت الحيوية تحت سطح البحر عناصر أساسية لاستمرار الاقتصاد الرقمي العالمي وحركة التجارة الدولية وأمن الطاقة العالمي، الأمر الذي عزز الحاجة إلى منصات دولية متخصصة تناقش عستقبل حماية هذه الأصول الحيوية وتطوير آليات التعاون الدولي بشأنها.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وانطلاقًا من هذه المتغيرات، ينظم الملتقى في نسخته الرابعة تحت عنوان: مستقبل أمن قاع البحار وسلاسل الإمداد في بيئة عالمية متغيرة؛ ليعكس الأهمية المتزايدة لأمن البنية التحتية البحرية العميقة ودورها في دعم استقرار الاقتصاد العالمي وحركة التجارة والطاقة والاتصالات الدولية، كما يعبر عن التزام المملكة العربية السعودية بدعم الجهود الدولية الرامية إلى تعزيز أمن الممرات البحرية وحماية المصالح المشتركة للدول والشعوب.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويُجسد الملتقى كذلك أحد المسارات الاستثمارية الرئيسية التي تتبناها ستارتايم ضمن محور الأمن الوطني، والذي بمثل أحد مرتكزات فلسفة الاستثمار لدى الشركة؛ فستارتايم تؤمن بأن التحولات العالمية المتسارعة تتطلب تطوير منظومة أمنية متكاملة تشمل الأمن البحري وأمن سلاسل الإمداد والأمن السيبراني والأمن الاقتصادي، وتسعى من خلال مشاريعها النوعية إلى تهيئة منصات متخصصة تجمع الجهات الحكومية والخبراء والشركاء الدوليين بهدف تعزيز الجاهزية الوطنية ودعم استدامة التنمية الاقتصادية والاجتماعية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويستهدف الملتقى استقطاب نخبة من قادة القوات البحرية وصناع القرار والمسؤولين الحكوميين والخبراء الدوليين والشركات الصناعية والتقنية والمؤسسات البحثية المتخصصة، للمشاركة في حوار دولي رفيع المستوى حول مستقبل الآمن البحري والتحديات والفرص المرتبطة به؛ كما سيتناول عددًا من الموضوعات المحورية التي تشكل أولوية متنامية لدول والمنظمات الدولية، من بينها حماية البنية التحتية الرقمية في قاع البحار، وآمن الطاقة البحرية، ومرونة سلاسل الإمداد العالمية، والأمن السيبراني البحري، إضافة إلى دور الأنظمة غير المأهولة والذكاء الاصطناعي والتقنيات المتقدمة في تعزيز الأمن البحري ورفع كفاءة المراقبة والاستجابة وإدارة المخاطر.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وتعمل اللجنة العليا المنظمة للملتقى، تحت إشراف مباشر من اللجنة الإشرافية بالقوات البحرية الملكية السعودية، على تنفيذ خطة تحضيرية شاملة تتضمن تطوير البرنامج العلمي، والتنسيق مع الجهات الحكومية والعسكرية والدولية، واستقطاب المتحدثين والخبراء، وتجهيز البنية التشغيلية والفنية اللازمة لضمان تقديم تجربة احترافية تتناسب مع مكانة المملكة وأهمية الحدث؛ كما بدأت مؤسسات وخبراء وجهات مشاركة من أكثر من أربعين دولة تأكيد مشاركتهم في آعمال الملتقى، الأمر الذي يعكس مكانته المتنامية بوصفه منصة دولية للحوار والتعاون في قضايا الأمن البحري.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ويمثل الملتقى البحري السعودي الدولي نموذجًا عمليًا لتوجهات رؤية السعودية 2030 في تعزيز الحضور الدولي للمملكة، وتطوير الشراكات العالمية، ودعم موقعها كمركز إقليمي ودولي للأعمال والأحداث المتخصصة؛ كما يعكس الدور المتنامي الذي تؤديه المملكة في دعم الآمن البحري الدولي وحماية الممرات المائية الحيوية وتعزيز استقرار التجارة والطاقة العالمية، باعتبارها دولة محورية ترتبط مصالحها الاقتصادية والاستراتيجية بشكل مباشر بأمن البحار وسلامة حركة التجارة الدولية.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وترى ستارتايم أن نجاح الملتقى عبر نسخه السابقة يؤكد أهمية بناء منصات حوار متخصصة تجمع الخبرات الدولية وتدعم تبادل المعرفة وتعزز التعاون بين المؤسسات العسكرية والحكومية والصناعية والتقنية، خصوصًا في ظل التحديات المتزايدة التي تواجه البيئة البحرية العالمية. كما ينسجم ذلك مع رؤية الشركة الرامية إلى تطوير مشاريع وطنية ذات أثر مستدام تسهم في دعم مستهدفات المملكة وتعزيز التنافسية الوطنية وخلق قيمة معرفية واقتصادية طويلة المدى.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}

{"root":{"type":"root","children":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"وأكدت ستارتايم أن تنظيم النسخة الرابعة من الملتقى البحري السعودي الدولي يمثل امتدادًا لمسيرتها في تطوير فعاليات أعمال رفيعة المستوى ذات بعد دولي، ومحطة جديدة في رحلتها نحو بناء منصات حوار متخصصة تخدم القضايا الاستراتيجية ذات الأولوية، كما يعكس الحدث التزام ستارتايم بالمساهمة في دعم الأمن البحري العالمي وتعزيز التعاون الدولي وتطوير المعرفة المتخصصة، بما ينسجم مع رؤية السعودية وتطلعاتها نحو مستقبل أكثر أمنًا واستدامة وازدهارًا.","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":"","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"version":1}}
